notice-board: Nothing is pinned up yet. Battle rankings and merge recipe hints go up here once battles open.
arena: The arena gates are shut for now. Town trainers and the Champion will wait here once battles open, and rankings reset every Monday.
market-stall: The merchant is still unpacking crates. Soon anything a trainer sells here shows up for everyone else at half again the price.
merge-stone: Two Checklings go in. One rare Checkling comes out. Nobody knows who carved it, and the spirals are quiet for now.
bus: The bus to Kettle Creek. Never late. Occasionally not running, which is different.
bus-stop: Every trainer steps off the bus right here.
lantern: Lit every evening by nobody in particular.
bench: Where trainers wait for someone brave enough to challenge them.
rock: Bolt has inspected this rock. Bolt approves.
bush: It rustles sometimes. Usually it is just the wind.
